player_intent: Entering a source rifle idle or ready pose inherits outgoing loop progress rather than a stale dormant idle playhead.
acceptance_rule: Only new eligible grounded standing/crouch idle arrivals publish one finite source-validated phase request to continuous idle leaves. Actual AnimationTree clocks are used, snapshots remain independent, and same-state/first-state/active-fade/action/fire/reload/traversal/nonsource/disabled requests do not seek. Moving destinations remain unchanged and are not claimed source-identical.

nodes.role: Canonical AnimationTree clock and pose writer

must_not_change: source gait frequencies and directional weights
visual_check: Inspect real main standing/crouched rifle stops at early/middle/late: phase entry must not break feet, hands, source camera channels, or frozen outgoing pose. Headless proof is not full original motion parity.

system_delta.reason: Seed validated incoming idle leaf clocks once in the existing AnimationTree, preserving all protected clocks and rejecting unsafe whole-gait seeking.

candidate.system: Guarded event-time source idle phase transfer
